skills.trigger: When evaluating a large pleuropulmonary mass on chest X-ray to distinguish between aggressive sarcomas and benign or well-circumscribed lesions.
steps: Inspect the margins of the opacity: determine if they are sharply defined/circumscribed versus ill-defined or irregular.
Assess the internal density: look for heterogeneity (mixed opacities suggesting necrosis/hemorrhage) versus uniform homogeneity.

Differentiate based on findings: A large mass with ill-defined margins and heterogeneous opacity suggests an aggressive process like synovial sarcoma, whereas a sharply marginated, uniform mass suggests a benign or encapsulated lesion.
